title: Precedent
description: A rule generalized from answered decisions, confirmed by the decider (design parts 3.2 and 4.3). Derived counts (applications, overrules) are never stored.

conditions.description: Structured where possible, matched by script; text holds what cannot be structured.

exceptions.description: Cases explicitly not covered. Plain text needs a judgment to apply; an object with a structured "when" is matched by script, so a narrowing by overrule stays machine-checkable.

scope.description: all (the whole project; was project before HITLD-82) or area:<name>.

decider.description: Who decided the decision it came from: "owner", or the area owners' contributor IDs, comma-separated. A precedent resolves only questions its decider could have decided (design parts 4.3 and 4.5). One without a decider resolves nothing.

state.description: active or retired. A narrowed precedent is active with exceptions; the trust event precedent-narrowed records the narrowing (narrowed was a state before HITLD-82, read as active).

checked.description: When last confirmed still valid, and under which policy.

exception.description: A case the precedent does not cover: it does not apply to a question that meets every condition in "when".
